  • Replace a value used by views/workflows/criteria → 409 GLOBAL_SET_VALUE_IN_USE "Change or remove it in those views first" [FAIL]
  • Used In shows every place (incl. reports) → Fields + views only; reports "not listed here yet" (not_tracked: reports) [FAIL]
  • Safeguards (16 fields, 50 values on restore, locked/system fields) → 409 TOO_MANY_FIELDS; 422 "At most 50"; 422 FIELD_LOCKED / datatype; duplicate 409/422 [PASS]
  • UI: list + edit dialog → All present and working [PASS]
  • Permissions + audit → crm:global_set:view/manage; created/updated/deleted + value events [PASS]

Still failing:

  • Replace a value used by views/workflows/criteria: expected Change propagates to dependent places, actual 409 GLOBAL_SET_VALUE_IN_USE "Change or remove it in those views first"
  • Used In shows every place (incl. reports): expected Fields, views, workflows, reports, actual Fields + views only; reports "not listed here yet" (not_tracked: reports)
